column3: “Again and again” renders rising early and sending.
“How dare you” intensifies “why”; “against” specifies gathering toward Jeremiah.
“Palace” specifies house; “of the LORD” is not repeated after the New Gate.
“Hands” renders a singular hand; “what you think” renders in your eyes.
“Like a field” renders plowing Zion as a field; “a wooded ridge” renders plural forest heights.
“Anyone else” renders all Judah; “seek His favor” replaces entreating the LORD’s face, and “ourselves” renders our souls.
“In fear” combines hearing and being afraid with fleeing.
The direct striking and throwing are rendered as actions the king had done; “common people” renders sons of the people.
“Supported Jeremiah” replaces the hand being with him.
